description: Bounded public excerpts from the stopped MemConflict schema-path acceptance. Saved decisions are historical, not approvals for new prose.
source_title: MemConflict: Evaluating Long-Term Memory Systems Under Memory Conflicts

claims.text: Problem: MemConflict 将 temporal validity 定义为记忆在查询时是否匹配真实用户状态。
claims.original_text: Problem: MemConflict defines temporal validity by whether a memory matches the true user state at query time.

evidence.quote: A memory item is temporally valid if it matches the true user state at query time

claims.text: Problem: Static conflicts 指矛盾的提及挑战 factual correctness，但不代表真实状态更新。
claims.original_text: Problem: Static conflicts model contradictory mentions that do not represent true state updates.

evidence.quote: Static conflicts arise when contradictory mentions challenge factual correctness without representing true state updates.

claims.text: Problem: Conditional conflicts 指多个值看似合理，但只有匹配查询上下文的 value-condition association 适用。
claims.original_text: Problem: Conditional conflicts test whether the system selects the value-condition association that matches the query.

evidence.quote: Conditional conflicts arise when multiple values appear plausible, but only the value-condition association matching the query context is applicable.

claims.text: Problem: 基准构造保证每个查询有唯一的 gold candidate。
claims.original_text: Problem: Benchmark construction assumes a unique gold candidate for each query.

evidence.quote: The benchmark construction guarantees a unique maximizer for each query.

claims.text: Solution: 用户 profile 由从 Persona Hub 采样得到的 persona seeds 初始化。
claims.original_text: Solution: User profiles are initialized from persona seeds sampled from Persona Hub.

evidence.quote: MemConflict initializes each user from a persona seed 𝑧𝑢 sampled from Persona Hub2.

claims.text: Solution: 模拟时间线覆盖 2022 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月，并按月组织 session slots。
claims.original_text: Solution: The simulated timeline spans January 2022 through December 2025 with monthly session slots.

evidence.quote: The timeline spans January 2022 to December 2025, with observed sessions organized at monthly granularity.

claims.text: Experiment: 基准包含 12 个 instances，每个对应一个 virtual user。
claims.original_text: Experiment: The benchmark contains 12 instances, each corresponding to one virtual user.

evidence.quote: We constructed 12 benchmark instances.

claims.text: Experiment: 每个 benchmark instance 平均包含 52.33 sessions。
claims.original_text: Experiment: Each benchmark instance contains an average of 52.33 sessions.

evidence.quote: On average, each instance contains 52.33 sessions

claims.text: Experiment: 每个 benchmark instance 平均上下文长度为 203,910.83 tokens。
claims.original_text: Experiment: Each benchmark instance contains an average context length of 203,910.83 tokens.

claims.text: Experiment: 每个 benchmark instance 平均包含 124.33 evaluation queries。
claims.original_text: Experiment: Each benchmark instance contains an average of 124.33 evaluation queries.

evidence.quote: with 124.33 evaluation queries.

claims.text: Experiment: 被评估系统为 A-Mem、LangMem、Letta、MemOS、Mem0 和 Memobase。
claims.original_text: Experiment: The evaluated systems are A-Mem, LangMem, Letta, MemOS, Mem0, and Memobase.

evidence.quote: We evaluate six representative long-term memory systems: A-Mem [37], LangMem3, Letta4, MemOS [12], Mem0 [4], and Memobase5.

claims.text: Experiment: 论文报告 benchmark-construction calls 和需要 LLM 的 memory-system backends 使用 gpt-5.0-mini。
claims.original_text: Experiment: The paper reports using gpt-5.0-mini for benchmark-construction calls and memory-system backends that require an LLM.

evidence.quote: All LLM calls used in benchmark construction, including profile generation, dialogue generation, query generation, and memory-system backends that require an LLM, usegpt-5.0-mini.

claims.text: Experiment: Answer Accuracy 评估最终答案的正确性。
claims.original_text: Experiment: Answer Accuracy evaluates correctness of the final answer.

evidence.quote: Black-box evaluation measures whether the system returns the correct final answer

claims.text: Experiment: SRS 根据 gold memory 的排名给出对数折扣分数，未检索到时记 0。
claims.original_text: Experiment: SRS gives a logarithmically discounted score based on the gold memory's rank and zero when it is not retrieved.

evidence.quote: SRS assigns a logarithmically discounted score according to its rank, and assigns 0 when it is not retrieved:

claims.text: Experiment: UOCS 衡量系统是否识别真实 update，并保留旧状态到新状态的 temporal order。
claims.original_text: Experiment: UOCS measures recognition of a true update and preservation of the old-to-new temporal order.

evidence.quote: Update Order Consistency Score (UOCS) measures whether the system recognizes that a true update has occurred and preserves the temporal order between earlier and later states

claims.text: Experiment: CRS 衡量系统是否识别 contradictory information 的存在。
claims.original_text: Experiment: CRS measures recognition that contradictory information is present.

evidence.quote: Conflict Recognition Score (CRS) measures whether the system identifies the presence of contradictory information:

claims.text: Experiment: Answer 和 memory-item 判断使用 LLM-assisted matching，随后进行 human verification。
claims.original_text: Experiment: Answer and memory-item judgments use LLM-assisted matching followed by human verification.

evidence.quote: All answer and memory-item judgments are produced through LLM-assisted matching followed by human verification.

claims.text: Experiment: 没有 evaluated system 在所有报告的 metrics 和 conflict types 上占优。
claims.original_text: Experiment: No evaluated system dominates all reported metrics and conflict types.

evidence.quote: No system dominates all metrics and conflict types.

claims.text: Experiment: 作者报告 MemOS 有最高 average AA、static AA、conditional AA 和 UOCS，而 LangMem 有最高 dynamic AA。
claims.original_text: Experiment: The authors report that MemOS has the highest average AA, static AA, conditional AA, and UOCS, while LangMem has the highest dynamic AA.

evidence.quote: MemOS achieves the highest average AA, with the best static and conditional AA and the highest UOCS, although LangMem obtains the highest dynamic AA.

claims.text: Experiment: 作者报告，被评估系统中的最高 CRS 为 0.2501。
claims.original_text: Experiment: The authors report that the highest CRS among the evaluated systems is 0.2501.

evidence.quote: CRS remains low for all systems, with the best score only reaching 0.2501

claims.text: Experiment: 作者报告 MemOS 有最高 average SEH@3 和 SRS。
claims.original_text: Experiment: The authors report that MemOS has the highest average SEH@3 and SRS.

evidence.quote: MemOS achieves the highest average SEH@3 and SRS

claims.text: Experiment: 在报告的长历史比较中，所有被评估系统的 performance 都下降。
claims.original_text: Experiment: In the reported longer-history comparison, performance decreases for all evaluated systems.

evidence.quote: Longer histories reduce performance for all evaluated systems, but the magnitude of degradation varies.

claims.text: Experiment: 在报告的对比中，移除 distractors 使所有六个系统的 performance 提升。
claims.original_text: Experiment: Removing distractors improves performance for all six systems in the reported comparison.

evidence.quote: Removing distractors improves performance for all systems, although the gains vary.

claims.text: Experiment: 与 direct queries 相比，implicit queries 通常降低 black-box 和 white-box performance，但随系统和 conflict type 变化。
claims.original_text: Experiment: Implicit queries generally reduce black-box and white-box performance relative to direct queries, with variation by system and conflict type.

evidence.quote: Compared with the direct-query setting, implicit queries generally reduce both black-box and white-box performance, although the effect varies across systems and conflict types.

claims.text: Experiment: 在报告的对比中，随着 conflict distance 增大，performance 下降。
claims.original_text: Experiment: Performance decreases as conflict distance increases in the reported comparison.

evidence.quote: Performance decreases as conflict distance increases across all systems.

claims.text: Experiment: 作者报告，在六个系统中，MemOS 有最低 total runtime、addition time 和 response time。
claims.original_text: Experiment: The authors report that MemOS has the lowest total runtime, addition time, and response time among the six systems.

evidence.quote: MemOS achieves the lowest total runtime, with the lowest addition time and response time.

claims.text: Experiment: 失败分解将多数系统和 conflict types 的错误主导份额归因于 retrieval failures。
claims.original_text: Experiment: The failure breakdown attributes the dominant share of errors to retrieval failures for most systems and conflict types.

evidence.quote: Across most systems and conflict types, retrieval failures account for the dominant share of errors

claims.text: Limitations: 该基准通过受控模拟构建，而不是从自然发生的长期人类交互中收集。
claims.original_text: Limitations: The benchmark is constructed through controlled simulation rather than naturally occurring long-term human interactions.

evidence.quote: it is still constructed through controlled simulation rather than collected from naturally occurring long-term human interactions.

claims.text: Limitations: 当前基准聚焦于 temporal updates、factual contradictions 和 condition-dependent preferences。
claims.original_text: Limitations: The current benchmark focuses on temporal updates, factual contradictions, and condition-dependent preferences.

evidence.quote: the current benchmark focuses on a specific set of memory difficulties, namely temporal updates, factual contradictions, and condition-dependent preferences

claims.text: Limitations: 实验评估的是一组有代表性但有限的 memory systems。
claims.original_text: Limitations: The experiments evaluate a limited set of memory systems.

evidence.quote: our experiments evaluate a representative but limited set of memory systems

claims.text: Limitations: white-box protocol 假设支持 gold answer 的 memory items 可以被显式检索和排序。
claims.original_text: Limitations: The white-box protocol assumes that gold-supporting memory items can be explicitly retrieved and ranked.

evidence.quote: the current white-box protocol assumes that memory items supporting the gold answer can be explicitly retrieved and ranked

claims.text: Limitations: 作者将 multilingual、multimodal 以及 multi-user 或 multi-agent 设置列为未来扩展。
claims.original_text: Limitations: The authors identify multilingual, multimodal, and multi-user or multi-agent settings as future extensions.

evidence.quote: A natural extension is to broaden MemConflict to more realistic and diverse interaction settings, including multilingual conversations, multimodal memory, and memory involving multiple interacting users or agents.

claims.text: Essence: MemConflict 沿 temporal validity、factual correctness 和 contextual applicability 三个互补维度定义 memory validity。
claims.original_text: Essence: MemConflict evaluates memory validity along temporal, factual, and contextual dimensions.

evidence.quote: MemConflict defines memory validity along three complementary dimensions: temporal validity, factual correctness, and contextual applicability.

paragraphs.text: MemConflict 沿 temporal validity、factual correctness 和 contextual applicability 三个互补维度定义 memory validity (c37)。

其中，temporal validity 的判断标准是记忆在查询时是否匹配真实用户状态 (c1)。Static conflicts 指矛盾的提及挑战 factual correctness、但不代表真实状态更新的情形 (c2)；Conditional conflicts 指多个值看似合理、但只有匹配查询上下文的 value-condition association 才适用的情形 (c3)。基准构造保证每个查询有唯一 gold candidate (c4)。
构造上，MemConflict 用从 Persona Hub 采样得到的 persona seeds 初始化每个用户 (c5)。模拟时间线覆盖 2022 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月，观察到的 sessions 按月度粒度组织 (c6)。
数据流中，论文报告 benchmark-construction calls 和需要 LLM 的 memory-system backends 使用 gpt-5.0-mini (c13)。
基准规模方面，作者构造了 12 个 benchmark instances，每个 instance 对应一个 virtual user (c7)；平均每个 instance 包含 52.33 sessions (c8)、203,910.83 tokens 的上下文长度 (c9) 和 124.33 evaluation queries (c10)。

评估指标覆盖不同结果阶段：Answer Accuracy 判断最终答案是否正确 (c14)；SRS 按 gold memory 的排名给出对数折扣分数，未检索到时记 0 (c16)；UOCS 检查系统是否识别真实 update 并保留旧到新的 temporal order (c17)；CRS 检查系统是否识别 contradictory information 的存在 (c18)。答案与 memory-item 的判断由 LLM-assisted matching 产生，再经 human verification (c19)。

实验比较 A-Mem、LangMem、Letta、MemOS、Mem0 和 Memobase 六个长期记忆系统 (c11)。在作者报告的跨 metrics 和 conflict types 比较中，没有 system 在所有指标和冲突类型上占优 (c20)；MemOS 取得最高 average AA，并在 static AA、conditional AA 和 UOCS 上最高，LangMem 取得最高 dynamic AA (c21)，而 CRS 的最高报告值为 0.2501 (c22)。在 SEH@3 和 SRS 上，作者报告 MemOS 有最高 average SEH@3 和 SRS (c23)。
在 query formulation 的条件比较中，与 direct-query 设置相比，implicit queries 通常降低 black-box 和 white-box performance，但影响随系统和 conflict type 变化 (c26)。
运行时比较中，作者报告 MemOS 在六个系统里拥有最低 total runtime，同时 addition time 和 response time 也最低 (c28)。
错误分解方面，在多数系统和 conflict types 中，retrieval failures 占错误的主导份额 (c29)。

作者列出的限制包括：该基准通过受控模拟构建，而不是从自然发生的长期人类交互中收集 (c30)；当前基准聚焦于 temporal updates、factual contradictions 和 condition-dependent preferences (c31)；实验评估的是一组有代表性但有限的 memory systems (c32)。white-box protocol 还假设支持 gold answer 的 memory items 能被显式检索和排序 (c33)，未来扩展则指向 multilingual、multimodal 以及 multi-user 或 multi-agent 设置 (c34)。
